as_told.title: Brown at Martin Corporation the year Skunkworks was formed

plain: Michels says that the researcher Thomas Townsend Brown, after a long stint in the Navy, was suddenly let go in 1942 with no explanation despite strong performance, and then joined the Martin aircraft company the same year Skunk Works, Lockheed's secret aircraft design shop in Burbank, California, under the engineer Kelly Johnson, was formed. Michels tells this himself across three episodes, once crediting naval records and once Brown's FBI file, and only the first telling mentions the unexplained firing, while another gives the year as 1942 or 1943. He raises it to suggest Brown's work drew quiet interest at high levels of aerospace.
